description.en-US: A short fantastic tale from 1928, in which the sword of a boy's game and the sword of a knight prove to be, for a moment, the same thing.
description.pt-BR: Um breve conto fantástico de 1928, em que a espada de brinquedo de um menino e a espada de um cavaleiro se mostram, por um instante, a mesma coisa.

sources.edition: The Sword of Wood (E. Mathews & Marrot, 1928), Project Gutenberg Australia, ebooks09/0900731h.
sources.description: Chapter divisions as printed; Gutenberg front and back matter dropped, line wraps joined, underscored italics converted, double hyphens set as em dashes. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain in Brazil, the UK and the EU (Chesterton died in 1936). Published in 1928; text taken from Project Gutenberg Australia, which carries it under Australian law.
